Mourning's scoring and rebounding improved over the next two seasons, but his shot-blocking declined significantly, as his taller teammate [Dikembe Mutombo](/wiki/Dikembe_Mutombo "Dikembe Mutombo") established himself as starting center for Georgetown, forcing Mourning to play at power forward. As a descendant of the Zen'in clan, Megumi wields the Ten Shadows Technique (十種影法術, *Tokusa no Kage Bōjutsu*), summoning *[shikigami](/wiki/Shikigami "Shikigami")* (式神) from shadows to exorcise Curses. In the Culling Games, he fights to save his sister Tsumiki, only for Sukuna to possess him after Yorozu's defeat. Sukuna exploits Megumi's despair, using Mahoraga to kill Tsumiki. During Gojo's battle with Sukuna, Megumi endures Infinite Void's effects. Though initially unresponsive, he later resists Sukuna's control after Yuji's intervention.

In mid-2018, the subscriber count of the Indian music video channel [T-Series](/wiki/T-Series_(company) "T-Series (company)") rapidly approached that of Swedish web comedian and Let's Player [PewDiePie](/wiki/PewDiePie "PewDiePie"), who was the most-subscribed user on YouTube at the time.[[98]](#cite_note-105)[[99]](#cite_note-106) As a result, fans of PewDiePie and T-Series, other YouTubers, and celebrities [showed their support for both channels](/wiki/PewDiePie_vs_T-Series "PewDiePie vs T-Series"). During the competition, both channels gained a large number of subscribers at a rapid rate, and surpassed each other's subscriber count on multiple occasions in February, March, and April 2019.[[70]](#cite_note-Trenholm-76)[[71]](#cite_note-Hamilton-77)[[72]](#cite_note-Spangler-78)[[74]](#cite_note-BBCNews-80) T-Series eventually permanently surpassed PewDiePie, and on May 29, 2019, it became the first channel to reach 100 million subscribers.[[91]](#cite_note-Rosseinsky-98)

In 2024, when MrBeast surpassed T-Series, he [tweeted](/wiki/Tweet_(social_media) "Tweet (social media)") that his fans had "avenged" PewDiePie.[[80]](#cite_note-Davis-87) In the lead-up to MrBeast's channel becoming the most-subscribed, T-Series issued a call for subscribers.[[100]](#cite_note-107) Meanwhile, MrBeast urged his fans to not see the competition between his channel and T-Series as "this country versus that country", while also warning against anyone becoming hateful.[[101]](#cite_note-108)
